records.alt: The B-24D Lady Be Good lying largely intact in the Libyan Desert after its discovery.
records.evidence: Official DoD-hosted original URL with VIRIN in filename; the item-level photo catalog is not independently located.
records.credit: U.S. Air Force, exact catalog record pending
records.rights_note: DoD source does not alone establish item-level rights.
records.editorial_note: Confirm whether visible image shows the intact aircraft before considering alternatives.

web_retriever_observation.context: independent web retriever, NOT guest browser

records.alt: The nine members of the Lady Be Good crew posed in front of a B-24 before the 1943 mission.
records.evidence: Official Air Force museum page uses the exact VIRIN and describes nine crew members.
records.rights_note: Museum labels photo public domain with credit and DoD use limitations.
records.editorial_note: The crew group is identified, but the exact aircraft/date of the posed image needs verification.

records.alt: The preserved wreck of Lady Be Good in the Libyan Desert.
records.evidence: Official USAF photo and Commons original use 050606-F-1234P-014; Commons reports 1800x1192 original.
records.rights_note: Museum labels photo public domain and Commons lists PD-USAirForce; item-level release review remains.
records.editorial_note: Official caption emphasizes aircraft parts strewn beside crash site, not undamaged aircraft.

records.alt: The Model 1910 canteen recovered from the Lady Be Good crew's desert trail.
records.evidence: Army September 2012 exhibit documents the canteen; original displayed photo is not pixel verified.
records.credit: U.S. Army Quartermaster Museum, September 2012 exhibit
records.rights_note: Museum provenance does not itself clear photographer rights in exhibit photos.
records.editorial_note: Current ALT specifies recovery from the crew's desert trail, whereas museum page establishes artifact provenance, not that exact find location.

web_retriever_observation.context: independent web retriever, NOT guest browser

records.alt: A page from Robert Toner's diary recovered with members of the Lady Be Good crew.
records.evidence: NARA catalog supplies two Toner diary photos but the privately hosted page is not proved identical to either.
records.credit: Original private host rights unknown; NARA diary alternative source only
records.rights_note: Neither diary age nor a NARA alternate photo clears the private hosted image rights.
records.editorial_note: Do not silently substitute another diary page; actual handwriting/crop identity must match.

records.alt: U.S. military investigators examining the Lady Be Good wreck in the Libyan Desert.
records.evidence: NARA blog attachment page exactly identifies 111-C-17240, matching hosted image basename.
records.rights_note: Specific photo rights and attribution need per-item review notwithstanding agency hosting.
records.editorial_note: Attachment title alone does not establish whether depicted people are examining the bomber.

records.alt: Search and recovery personnel working around Lady Be Good in the Libyan Desert.
records.evidence: Official Air Force caption calls this a tail view of Lady Be Good with a C-47 in background.
records.rights_note: Museum labels this photo public domain with appropriate credit and DoD limitations.
records.editorial_note: Published ALT asserts personnel working around bomber; official says tail view and C-47 recovery plane. Proposed ALT: Tail of Lady Be Good in Libyan Desert, with C-47 recovery plane in background.
